svg.title: shot-speak session replay
svg.desc: An animated replay of a shot-speak session: I want my dog to do a bullet time thingy when I throw him a bone, dramatically. The user describes a shot, the tool plans 4 options, checks them, shows the cost, shows 4 cards, and writes the final prompt.
svg.text: shot-speak: a session replay (real tool output)

g.text: I want my dog to do a bullet time thingy when I throw him a bone, dramatically.
I want my dog to do a bullet time thingy when I throw him a bone, dramatically.
At most 1 question, and only when the answer changes the options.
I want my dog to do a bullet time thingy when I throw him a bone, dramatically.
That my dog is a legend.
$ shotspeak.py plan --phrase "I want my dog to do a bullet time thingy when I throw him a…" ...
What your words mean in film language:
- 'Bullet time' is a frozen-moment arc: time almost stops while the camera moves.
- 'Dramatic' is not one technique. It is a choice of camera position, lens, light and speed.
Subject: a scruffy brown dog at the top of a jump, about to catch a thrown bone. Place: a backyard lawn…
Note: Options A, B slow time down. In a finished piece, use slow motion for 1 beat only.
